question: For a real number $\alpha$, let $S_\alpha$ denote the set of those real numbers $\beta$ that satisfy $\alpha\sin(\beta)=\beta\sin(\alpha)$. Then which of the following statements is true?

options.A: For any $\alpha$, $S_\alpha$ is an infinite set.
options.B: $S_\alpha$ is a finite set if and only if $\alpha$ is not an integer multiple of $\pi$.
options.C: There are infinitely many numbers $\alpha$ for which $S_\alpha$ is the set of all real numbers.
